n = int(input())
s = input()

# Replace all double underscores with single underscore
while "__" in s:
    s = s.replace("__", "_")

wins = 0
maxLen = 0
n = len(s)

i = 0
j = 0

# Check if the string starts with '(' and process the first segment
if s and s[0] == '(':
    j = 0
    while j < n and s[j] != ')':
        j += 1
    if j < n and s[j] == ')':
        temp = s[i + 1:j]
        if "_" not in temp and len(temp) > 0:
            wins += 1
        else:
            tokens = temp.split("_")
            wins += len(tokens)
        i = j + 1

# Process all other parentheses segments
k = 0
while k < n:
    if s[k] == '(':
        l = k
        while l < n and s[l] != ')':
            l += 1
        if l < n and s[l] == ')':
            temp = s[k + 1:l]
            if "_" not in temp and len(temp) > 0:
                wins += 1
            else:
                tokens = temp.split("_")
                wins += len(tokens)
            k = l
    k += 1

# Remove all parentheses and their contents
import re
while '(' in s or ')' in s:
    s = re.sub(r'\([^()]*\)', '_', s)

# Find the maximum length of parts separated by underscores
parts = s.split('_')
for part in parts:
    if len(part) > maxLen:
        maxLen = len(part)

print(f"{maxLen} {wins}")
